title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
summary: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $636 Million as October Turns Red Again
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $635.6 million on Thursday, their biggest outflow of the month, pushing October flows back to a loss of about $176 million as Ethereum and Solana funds also bled.

title: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Testnet Fork Over Gas Security Flaws
summary: The Hoodi testnet fork is off after ChainSecurity found gas changes that could let contracts lock in failures, citing 13 real-world cases.

title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
summary: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.

title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
summary: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

title: Uniswap’s aggregator hooks go live on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain
summary: Uniswap Labs has launched aggregator hooks, allowing Uniswap v4 to route trades through liquidity held on external platforms.
